# Stewardmark

> Fractional CIO leadership, AI agents, and AI governance for organizations of 25 and larger. Run by Christopher Fryer, a former CIO of an AmLaw 200 law firm who still builds and runs AI systems. Based in Berkeley, California.

Stewardmark is a single-consultant practice. Clients work directly with Christopher Fryer. Advice is independent: no vendor commissions, no markups, no resale margins. Custom software is delivered with partner Number Zoo (https://numberzoo.ai).

## Services

- [Fractional and interim CIO services](https://stewardmark.ai/services/fractional-cio): Strategy, budget, security, vendor oversight, and board reporting, delivered in days per month instead of headcount.
- [AI agent consulting and implementation](https://stewardmark.ai/services/ai-agents): Find where AI agents save real time, pilot one workflow safely, and scale it with governance.
- [Custom software and workflow automation](https://stewardmark.ai/services/custom-software): Targeted development that removes friction without replacing the systems an organization depends on.
- [AI governance and AI readiness reviews](https://stewardmark.ai/services/ai-governance): Practical AI policy and right-sized oversight, with ready answers for clients, funders, insurers, and regulators.
- [Independent technology assessment](https://stewardmark.ai/services/technology-assessment): Vendor-neutral evaluation of platforms, contracts, roadmaps, and security, with a recommendation in plain language.
- [Technology leadership mentoring](https://stewardmark.ai/services/technology-leadership-mentoring): One-on-one mentoring for IT directors and rising technology leaders from a former CIO.

## About

- [Christopher Fryer](https://stewardmark.ai/about): 25+ years of technology leadership, including 12 years as CIO of Hanson Bridgett, a professional services firm of about 410 people, leading a 26-person team and a technology budget of more than $7M.
- Location: Berkeley, California. Works with organizations across the San Francisco Bay Area and nationwide.
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/christopherjfryer/

## Articles

- [Your staff are already using AI. Start with a one-page policy.](https://stewardmark.ai/articles/one-page-ai-policy): What a one-page AI use policy covers and how to put one in place in about a month.
- [Managing training and data retention across Claude plans](https://stewardmark.ai/articles/claude-training-and-data-retention): What each Claude plan does by default, how to stop training, and where zero data retention is available.
- [Managing training and data retention across ChatGPT and OpenAI plans](https://stewardmark.ai/articles/chatgpt-training-and-data-retention): What each ChatGPT plan and the API do by default, how to stop training, and where zero data retention is available.
- [Your firm's AI policy needs a second page](https://stewardmark.ai/articles/ai-policy-second-page): Co-authored with Gail Jefferson. What California's SB 574 and the Third Circuit's ROSS ruling add to a law firm's AI policy.
